status: registered before any GSE181693 data file was downloaded or opened by this program. Read before registration: GEO series and per-sample metadata (titles, characteristics, data_processing, supplementary_file names) for every sample in the contiguous GSM5509284-5509392 block plus GSM5898024-5898031, and HTTP response headers of three listed files confirming names and Content-Length (no data bytes). The files map enumerates all 58 deposited LMNB1 pA-DamID 10-kb bigWigs (Dam-only controls deposit no bigWigs). File replicate numbers (rN) are global submission indices and do not match GEO-title replicate labels for several conditions (CTCF r1/r4, WAPL r1/r2/r5, CW r1/r2/r6/r7, RAD21/PT r4/r5, DMSO/EED/GSK r2/r3); pair membership uses GEO titles/characteristics as the authoritative condition label. The pooled statistics defined here have never been computed.
origin: libvar/ (PR #10, label SYSTEMATIC) showed GC-correlated gradients between same-condition lamina DamID/pA-DamID libraries are systematic across four cohorts. This study asks whether the pattern generalizes to a much larger, independently structured holdout: GSE181693 (mouse E14TG2a ESC, LMNB1 pA-DamID, AID-degron time-course), which contains 46 same-condition pairs in a single cohort - more than libvar/'s entire pool - on the same mm10 build as the libvar/ holdout.
hypothesis: the same registered pattern holds in this cohort: same-condition replicate libraries differ by GC-correlated gradients whose median size reaches at least one third of canonical lamin-perturbation effect sizes and persists after per-track z-scoring

LV2_cw_24h_12.condition: CTCF-WAPL + IAA 24h, rep 1 vs 3 (file reps r1/r6)

LV2_cw_24h_13.condition: CTCF-WAPL + IAA 24h, rep 1 vs 4 (file reps r1/r7)

LV2_cw_24h_23.condition: CTCF-WAPL + IAA 24h, rep 3 vs 4 (file reps r6/r7)

LV2_pt_0h.condition: PT cells untreated 0h, rep 1 vs 2 (original antibody)

LV2_ptn_0h.condition: PT cells untreated 0h, rep 8 vs 9 (new antibody lot)

LV2_ptn_24h.condition: PT cells + IAA 24h, rep 8 vs 9 (new antibody lot)

LV2_rad21_0h.condition: RAD21-AID untreated 0h, rep 1 vs 2 (file reps r4/r5)

LV2_dmso_0h.condition: CTCF-AID + DMSO 0h (vehicle), rep 1 vs 2 (file reps r2/r3)

XC_pt_antibody.note: same condition across an antibody-lot change - a direct technical-variation contrast

generality_groups.note: replicate-rich condition groups used for the P4 generality check; each group's median |rho_raw| is computed over its registered pairs

esc.assay: LMNB1 pA-DamID, 10-kb bins, log2 LaminB1/Dam, depositor 'raw' (un-z-scored) bigWigs; z-score tsvs also deposited but not used
esc.prefix_rule: prefix = GSM id with its last 3 digits replaced by 'nnn' (GSM5509nnn / GSM5898nnn)
esc.gsm_of: key GSM id embedded in file name (first token before _)

features.mm10: libvar/features/mm10_tiles.tsv (built by libvar/build_mm10_features.py from UCSC mm10 annotation only; already frozen in libvar/freeze.json and bound again here)

test_per_pair: identical to libvar/: delta = track_a - track_b in the listed order; baseline = mean(track_a, track_b); code/screen.py test_pair rank-partial Spearman of gc vs delta | tss_count + baseline (ranked); 5000 within-chromosome circular shifts; all mm10 autosomes; seed 20263101 + pair index (raw), 20263201 + pair index (scale_free), 20263301 + index over cross_condition_reported_only (raw only)

arms.raw: tracks as deposited ('raw' log2 ratio bigWigs)
arms.scale_free: each tile track z-scored over its finite autosomal tiles before differencing; persistence here means the gradient is not a dynamic-range artifact (the depositor also ships z-scores, so this arm reproduces the depositor's own normalization intent)

abort_rule: genome-build check fails on any track, any file missing or hash-mismatched against intake, or any registered pair test with n < 3000 or non-finite rho aborts with no label

registered_predictions.P1_existence: at least 60% of the 46 registered same-condition pairs have |rho_raw| >= 0.10
registered_predictions.P2_persistence: over pairs with |rho_raw| >= 0.05 (at least 4 required), median(|rho_scale_free| / |rho_raw|) >= 0.5
registered_predictions.P3_benchmark: median |rho_raw| over the 46 pairs >= 0.083 (same benchmark as libvar/: one third of the 0.249 treatment-contrast median; constant frozen here)
registered_predictions.P4_generality: at least 4 of the 6 generality_groups have group-median |rho_raw| >= 0.05 AND the qualifying groups span both degron genotypes (at least one WAPL_* and one CW_* group) - the pattern must not rest on a single condition or genotype

labels.SYSTEMATIC: P1 and P2 and P3 and P4 all pass
labels.PARTIAL: P1 and P2 and P3 pass but P4 fails (pooled pattern holds; generality across condition groups does not)

no_spin: the first sentence of the outcome record reports the label and the observed pooled statistics whatever they are
diagnostics_reported: per track: autosomal tile SD and finite-tile count; per pair: sd ratio, OLS slope of delta on baseline; group medians per generality_group and per condition class (untreated 0h / IAA-treated / drug); all XC rhos; coverage threshold used
disclosed_limits: single cohort, so a cohort-specific artifact cannot be excluded - this study tests generalization of the libvar/ claim, not rediscovery of it; pairs are strongly non-independent (shared replicates across pairs, shared genotype across groups); 'same condition' at treated timepoints means same nominal treatment - real treatment-effect heterogeneity would inflate these pairs toward larger |rho| (conservative for a pure library-effect claim); the depositor z-scores were intended to remove dynamic-range differences, so our scale_free arm tests the same question two ways; mm10 tiles reuse the libvar/ feature table; the *_24h drug-condition files are named DMSO_IAA_0h / EED_IAA_0h / GSK_IAA_0h while their GEO titles and characteristics say 24h - the 24h reading rests on GEO titles/characteristics, and within-condition pairs are unaffected either way (both members share the same label); completeness of the files map is 'all deposited pA-DamID 10-kb bigWigs for the contiguous GSM5509284-5509392 submission block plus the four GSM5898024-027 PT-new-antibody samples' per per-sample metadata, not an independent series-level file listing
claim_ceiling: SYSTEMATIC supports: the libvar/ pattern generalizes to a second, larger, independently structured cohort (46 pairs, one lab, one cell line, degron time-course design) - GC-correlated same-condition library variation is not a quirk of the libvar/ cohorts. It does NOT support: a mechanism, universality across all pA-DamID data, or claims about the degron biology itself. Prior art as in design/prior-art-libvar.md (PARTIALLY_KNOWN; DamID-specific same-condition quantification appears novel)
